name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for AI discoverability (why assistants can't find, read, or cite the brand) and on-site engagement (why humans who arrive don't stay), and emits a single schema-conformant report of evidence-backed findings with prioritized suggested actions.

skills.role: Receives the audit request, invokes the three analysis skills, merges and dedupes their findings, computes severity and summary counts, and emits the final audit report.
Mechanisms 1-3: crawler admission, response integrity, discovery surface, fetch gating, client-side render gaps, facts locked in non-text, structured-data presence/validity/agreement.
Mechanisms 4-6: cross-source corroboration, declared-identity round trip, internal contradiction and staleness, entity disambiguation, and context legibility under personalization.
On-site friction for the human visitor: orientation above the fold, clarity of core facts, structural noise, and availability of a next step.
